# Design

Every addition is a new command in the existing dispatch plus one new module (src/orchestrate.c). Accuracy work stays table-driven inside the existing regex engine: real scope ends, persistent string state, qualifier capture, and an imports table — no parser dependency. Retrieval gains a shared ranking function, deterministic ordering, and byte budgets threaded from CLI and MCP. Sessions become a first-class handoff artifact stored as superseding memories. Orchestration composes claim-next, resume prompts, and fork/exec drivers; the VS Code extension attaches terminals to claims. No new link-time dependencies.

## Structure

- src/lang.c — scope ends, string state, qualifiers, table-driven imports
- src/graph.c — find_symbols_all ranking, import-aware resolution, budgets, compact emission
- src/spec.c + src/govern.c — ready frontier, atomic claim-next, per-agent identity, handoff/resume
- src/orchestrate.c — cg spec run driver loop (new module)
- editors/vscode/agents.js — terminal-attached agent sessions (new module)
